未达最低成团人数前显示招募中；达到成团线后铁定出发并安排领队。: Before the minimum is reached it shows Recruiting. Once it confirms, it will depart and a leader is assigned.

也可打开「替代团」：本团未成团时，自动加入相同行程的其他日期。: You can also turn on a backup trip: if this one doesn't confirm, you move to another date of the same route.
请按行程页装备清单准备；儿童须由监护人确认风险告知。: Pack what's listed on the trip page. A guardian must confirm the risk notice for a child.
服从领队现场安排；中途退出须告知领队，下撤费用自理。: Follow the leader on site. If you leave early, tell the leader. The cost of getting down is yours.

可以加入候补。有人取消后按报名顺序自动递补并短信通知。候补期间不占座位。: You can join the waitlist. If someone cancels, the next person moves up and gets a text. Waitlist spots don't hold a seat.
建议购买户外意外险。不购买则出行风险自担。导游端能看到你是否已加购。: Accident cover is recommended. If you skip it, you carry the risk. The guide can see whether you added it.
添加官方微信后拉入用户群。本团咨询群由领队确认后显示在行程页。: Add the official WeChat account to join the user group. This trip's group shows on the trip page after the leader confirms it.
个人拼团先占座，费用待出行前支付；公司团由开团方统一结算。会员价在报名时按当时人: Personal trips hold a seat first and you pay before departure. Company trips are settled by the host. The member price uses the headcount tier at sign-up.

户外活动遇突发情况时，领队需要立刻联系你的家人或同伴。联系人手机不能与出行人手机: If something happens outdoors, the leader needs to reach your family or a companion right away. Their phone number can't be the same as the traveler's.
在「我的」申请收录线路，留下手机和微信。客服微信是「同行者众」。审核通过后会出现: From Me, ask to list a route and leave a phone number and WeChat. Support WeChat is 同行者众. After review it shows in the route list. Starting a trip is still the Start a trip button on Home.
平台官方团，出行前一天会并入同集合点未成团的个人/公司/高校团。: Official trip. The day before departure, unconfirmed personal, company, and campus trips with the same meeting point are merged in.
天气、景区封山等不可抗力导致无法出行时，由发起人解散或改期，已收款按解散规则处理: If weather or a mountain closure makes the trip impossible, the host dissolves or reschedules it and payments follow the dissolve rules.
一个团最多两位领队。还没有领队时可在行程页点「报名领队」。: A trip has at most two leaders. If there isn't one yet, tap Join as guide on the trip page.
报名后可勾选多个候选团：本团未成团时，按你选的顺序自动转到别的团，价格多退少补。: After you sign up you can pick backup trips. If this one doesn't confirm, you move down your list and the price is adjusted.
一个团一位摄影师。还没有时可在行程页点「报名摄影师」，免个人团费（保险另计）。: Each trip has one photographer. If there isn't one, tap Join as photographer on the trip page. Your trip fee is waived; insurance is separate.
早报名早选座。报名前点座位图会提示先报名；报名后可在座位图改座。: Earlier sign-ups pick seats first. Tapping the seat map before you sign up asks you to sign up. After that you can change seats.
候补未递补前取消，不影响在团人数。已付款按当时比例、按各付款人原路退回（演示立即: Cancelling while still on the waitlist doesn't change the headcount. Payments are refunded at the rate then in effect, back the way each person paid.
早报名早选座。报名前点空位会提示先报名；占用位可看个人主页。: Earlier sign-ups pick seats first. Tapping an empty seat before you join asks you to sign up. Occupied seats open that person's profile.
空位，点此带这团: Open spot. Tap to lead this trip.
空位，免个人团费: Open spot. No personal trip fee.
回来的行程都评过了。: You've reviewed the trips you've been on.
还没有退款记录。取消后会写在这里：退回余额或原路退回微信。: No refunds yet. After you cancel, this shows whether the money went back to your balance or to WeChat.
成团、集合点变更、审核结果和退款到账会出现在这里。: Group confirmation, meeting-point changes, review results, and refunds show up here.
还没有看过的线路。打开一条线路后会出现在这里。: No routes viewed yet. Open a route and it will show up here.
报名时点「存为常用」，下次可以点一下带入。: On the sign-up form, tap Save traveler. Next time you can fill it in with one tap.
在别人的主页点「关注」。对方再发团时，消息里会提醒你。: Tap Follow on someone's profile. When they publish a trip, you'll get a message.
关注的人发团了: Someone you follow published a trip
